title: New water connection (MCGM)
summary: Apply through a licensed plumber in your ward; after scrutiny, site visit and sanction the ward issues the Permission Form (P Form); after compliance the meter is connected and the connection released.

authority.name: Municipal Corporation of Greater Mumbai: Hydraulic Engineer's Department

sources.title: Section 4 Manuals as per provision of RTI Act 2005 of 'D' Ward: Assistant Engineer Water Work Department
Chapter 9 (Manual 8): Procedure followed in decision making process, Dy. H.E. (City)

steps.title: Apply through a licensed plumber
steps.description: Standard application forms are available in the wards; the application is submitted online in your ward through a Licensed Plumber, with the requisite documents. The JE/SE (Distribution) scrutinises it and writes to the applicant.
steps.department: Hydraulic Engineer's Department: Assistant Engineer (Water Works), ward office

documents.name: NOC from the Hydraulic Engineer's Department
Copy of plans approved by the Planning Authority
Copy of I.O.D. / amended plans / C.C.
Copy of Occupation Certificate / Building Completion Certificate
Copy of any other applicable NOC
Copy of rent receipt (if the applicant is a tenant)
Copy of valid licence to run the trade, issued by the MCGM
Nature of activity and staff engaged in the establishment
NOC from the owner / society (if the applicant is not the owner)

fee.note: Amount not stated in the reviewed MCGM sources.

officialSla.wording: Scrutiny of Application: 15 days (then letter to party: 2 days).

conditional.condition: Letter to the applicant after scrutiny

review.note: Time limits are from the MCGM Assistant Engineer (Water Works) RTI manuals: wards A, D, K-West, P-South and R-Central share this table. Wards H-East and L instead state 'Seven days (per scrutiny level)'. Check your ward's manual.

steps.title: Reply to the letter and pay the scrutiny fee
steps.description: Comply with the letter from the ward (the 'Dhakka' letter) and pay the scrutiny fee online; the applicant has 30 days.

fee.note: Amount not stated in the reviewed MCGM sources.

review.note: Time limits are from the MCGM Assistant Engineer (Water Works) RTI manuals: wards A, D, K-West, P-South and R-Central share this table. Wards H-East and L instead state 'Seven days (per scrutiny level)'. Check your ward's manual.

steps.title: Site visit
steps.description: After compliance with the letter, the JE/SE (Distribution) visits the site and files a report.
steps.department: Hydraulic Engineer's Department: Assistant Engineer (Water Works), ward office

fee.note: Amount not stated in the reviewed MCGM sources.

officialSla.wording: After compliance of Dakka letter site visit report: 7 days.

review.note: Time limits are from the MCGM Assistant Engineer (Water Works) RTI manuals: wards A, D, K-West, P-South and R-Central share this table. Wards H-East and L instead state 'Seven days (per scrutiny level)'. Check your ward's manual.

steps.title: Sanction by the competent authority
steps.description: The JE/SE puts up a proposal; the AEWW approves, rejects or forwards it; higher authorities (EEWW / Dy HE / HE / DMC) decide depending on the powers vested in them.

fee.note: Amount not stated in the reviewed MCGM sources.

officialSla.wording: After site visit put up proposal to higher authority for sanction: 15 days.

conditional.condition: Decision or forwarding by the AEWW
Approval by a higher competent authority (EEWW / Dy HE / HE / DMC), per level

review.note: Time limits are from the MCGM Assistant Engineer (Water Works) RTI manuals: wards A, D, K-West, P-South and R-Central share this table. Wards H-East and L instead state 'Seven days (per scrutiny level)'. Check your ward's manual.

steps.title: Receive the Permission Form (P Form) and C Form
steps.description: After approval the ward prepares and signs the Permission Form (P Form), which lists the approvals and conditions, and issues it with the connection form (C form) to the plumber / applicant.
steps.department: Hydraulic Engineer's Department: Assistant Engineer (Water Works), ward office

fee.note: Amount not stated in the reviewed MCGM sources.

officialSla.wording: Preparation of Permission Form (P Form): 7 days; signing: 7 days; issue with C form: 2 days.

conditional.condition: Signing of the P Form by the AEWW
Issue of the P Form with the C form

review.note: Time limits are from the MCGM Assistant Engineer (Water Works) RTI manuals: wards A, D, K-West, P-South and R-Central share this table. Wards H-East and L instead state 'Seven days (per scrutiny level)'. Check your ward's manual.

steps.title: Comply with the P Form and C Form conditions
steps.description: The plumber / applicant completes the conditions listed in the P Form and C Form; this must be done within one year.

fee.note: Amount not stated in the reviewed MCGM sources.

officialSla.note: Applicant's action: compliance within one year.

review.note: Time limits are from the MCGM Assistant Engineer (Water Works) RTI manuals: wards A, D, K-West, P-South and R-Central share this table. Wards H-East and L instead state 'Seven days (per scrutiny level)'. Check your ward's manual.

steps.title: Road opening permit
steps.description: The road opening permit for laying the connection is issued by the AE (Maintenance).

fee.note: Amount not stated in the reviewed MCGM sources.

review.note: Time limits are from the MCGM Assistant Engineer (Water Works) RTI manuals: wards A, D, K-West, P-South and R-Central share this table. Wards H-East and L instead state 'Seven days (per scrutiny level)'. Check your ward's manual.

steps.title: Meter card prepared
steps.description: The Meter Inspector / Meter Supervisor prepares the meter card.

fee.note: Amount not stated in the reviewed MCGM sources.

review.note: Time limits are from the MCGM Assistant Engineer (Water Works) RTI manuals: wards A, D, K-West, P-South and R-Central share this table. Wards H-East and L instead state 'Seven days (per scrutiny level)'. Check your ward's manual.

steps.title: Water meter physically connected
steps.description: The SE / JE (Maintenance) physically connects the water meter at the premises.

fee.note: Amount not stated in the reviewed MCGM sources.

officialSla.wording: Physical connection of water meter: 7 days.

review.note: Time limits are from the MCGM Assistant Engineer (Water Works) RTI manuals: wards A, D, K-West, P-South and R-Central share this table. Wards H-East and L instead state 'Seven days (per scrutiny level)'. Check your ward's manual.

steps.title: CCN number generated
steps.description: The CCN number is generated and the meter reading card updated.

fee.note: Amount not stated in the reviewed MCGM sources.

officialSla.wording: Generation of CCN Number and Updating of Meter Reading Card: 10 days.

review.note: Time limits are from the MCGM Assistant Engineer (Water Works) RTI manuals: wards A, D, K-West, P-South and R-Central share this table. Wards H-East and L instead state 'Seven days (per scrutiny level)'. Check your ward's manual.

steps.title: Water connection released
steps.description: After compliance with the P Form conditions, the water connection is released to the applicant.
